canonical_workers.definition: Unique worker_id across all source registries.

rendered_default.definition: In default 'selected_floor_and_groups' mode, no individual worker renders externally — count badges per floor instead. Selecting a floor renders workers for that floor only.

training_or_sim.definition: training_worker class — visible only in Training Academy interior.

legacy_unified_view.definition: Legacy merge of worker_sandbox + openclaw_sandbox + workers.json (sim_worker_floor_*). Sidebar reads this; label says 'showing X of Y canonical · Z SIM seeds'.

why_totals_can_differ: Multiple reconciliation paths coexist. V1 canonical is authoritative; legacy views remain for backward compat and are clearly labelled.
